agent_explanation: Emergency preemption at t=686 interrupts EW yellow after only 1s and jumps straight to NS green at step 687 with 0s all-red. Steps 685 (EW green, no event) -> 686 (EW yellow, emergency active) -> 687 (NS green) show the controller gives and keeps green to the emergency direction immediately, skipping the required yellow_duration (5s) and all_red (2s) clearance, causing all_red_clearance (and yellow_duration) violations.
